text:
tori-docs: Quick PR opened to clarify SOC2 wording in the audit-log migration guide and add an explicit redaction example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502. Can legal + security skim the updated phrasing?

legal_jane: Thanks. High-level: avoid absolutes like 'never' or 'always'. Use phrasing such as 'Redwood does not retain exported copies beyond the configured export retention window (example: 90 days) for hosted plans.' Add a placeholder note to finalize retention numbers with compliance.

security_ben: Security: please include KMS envelope encryption example and call out that reversible masking requires customer-managed keys. Add an ARN example for the KMS key. Also flag that exports should be written to customer-controlled storage in Private deployments.

ops-mike: Ops nit: include --concurrency in the migration CLI example and show a sample aws s3 cp line for copying exported bundles. Also show a presign example if customers prefer presigned URLs.

samir-docs: I'll update the PR: switch example fields to tokenized_actor_id, add a redacted audit JSON example, and include small SDK snippets for Node and Go to set redaction rules. Keep examples using placeholders like {PERSONAL_ID}.

docs-bot: PR #4502  CI checks: docs lint passed, link-checker running.

legal_jane: LGTM with the placeholder retention values. Please don't ship concrete PII examples; use placeholders in the sample events.

security_ben: LGTM after KMS ARN example added.

samir-docs: Updated and merged in the branch. Will wait for link-checker then merge. Thanks everyone!
